suite: V7 app action/state guards in Node VM
scope: Minimal DOM and fake Audio; real app.js, core.js and data.js are evaluated. No browser rendering, service worker, real audio, GPS, provider or live AI verified.

results.name: finishing before arrival and double-finishing cannot advance an unconfirmed next stop
arrival and manual playback context never complete a stop by themselves
skip confirmation is consumed once and cannot skip the next stop on a repeat event
+15 is a preview; discard leaves accepted duration/revision/progress unchanged
explicit +15 Apply changes only confirmed current duration and bumps one plan revision
explicit current +15 keeps a must-visit locked instead of silently unlocking it
pending +15 survives manual future edits and one explicit Apply
pending +15 survives Adjust remaining without allowing AI to change past/current identity
pending +15 cannot become +30 through an invalid proposal mutation
stale pending extension cannot overwrite a newer accepted plan
manual stale-revision review rejects overwrite after the editor opened
AI stale-revision protection uses the snapshot at Adjust entry, not late review creation
progress advancing while a manual preview waits makes that preview stale
forged disabled actions cannot remove, move or resize fixed prefix or locked future stop
adjust checkboxes cannot silently unlock an existing must-visit
manual future unlock requires confirmation and authorises only that draft removal
no-op manual review does not create a review or increment revision
header Back prompts for dirty editor and discard preserves the saved plan
Back from Add stop returns to the same unsaved draft without discard
unvisited unavailable current stop has an explicit replacement preview and safe apply
replacement of locked unavailable current stop requires explicit unlock consent
confirmed current stop cannot be replaced; only future editing is offered
arrival after replacement preview makes the replacement stale
resuming a paused tour requires confirmation before pausing another active tour
no reviewed mutation may change an earlier visited prefix even if the draft is corrupted
completed journeys cannot resume or be edited in place
new/adapted proposal selection cannot reuse the previous saved-trip route context
keeping current tour after pending adjustment clears the unapplied extension
an unsupported AI adjustment explains its refusal without changing active progress or a locked visit
cycling Home sheet visibility never creates or mutates a journey
welcome completion needs three steps and replay never resets saved trips
welcome Skip is available before completion and does not create a tour
direct template Start saves and activates once without an intermediate Ready route
Save for later and Start reuse one unchanged unstarted template copy for the same date
Start never overwrites a customized saved copy when opening the source template
another active trip must be explicitly paused before direct Start creates a new journey
canceling direct Start creates no copy and a canceled confirmation cannot switch another selected trip
Start switch confirmation becomes stale if the active stop changes while it waits
starting an AI proposal is one explicit acceptance and repeat events cannot create another copy
Home Search uses Explore and preserves the query across a place detail round trip
Home quick-plan time chips open one short form without saving or altering an existing trip
quick-plan generates an unsaved proposal and retains must-visits without touching the active tour
Ask from Detail opens a contextual sheet and closing it preserves the detail and active pointer
expanding contextual Ask to AI Guide retains its POI and Back returns to that same Detail
focused navigation can Ask about its current stop without leaving the leg or advancing progress
AI Guide handles city, POI and current-trip context while keeping their conversations separate
AI chat adjustment is a preview that preserves current/past and locked future visits until Apply
AI chat preview cannot overwrite a newer accepted revision
AI chat refuses unavailable or protected changes explicitly and never mutates the itinerary
switching standalone stories saves independent playback positions without changing trip progress
Back to current stop pauses separate listening and never autoplays the previous story
guest Profile and Settings stay optional and preserve an active journey
signup validates email, password, name and demo acknowledgement before creating a session
signup saves only a local demo profile and session, never its entered password
login rejects invalid input and opens an explicitly local session without storing a password
profile name editing requires a session, keeps the account email and leaves journeys unchanged
sign out requires its confirmation and clears only the local session
password recovery validates inputs but never changes a stored password, session or journey
signing back into the same local demo profile keeps its edited name and saved progress
Settings speed and motion persist across reload and reject unsupported playback speeds
changing playback speed in the story player updates Settings and survives reload
Settings exposes replay, downloads, privacy and capabilities without requiring sign-in
plain form controls inside a sheet retain native click defaults and do not trigger the backdrop
